interview.name: Hana
interview.answer: The repair drive is still on for Saturday, but the location isn’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Hana coordinates the repair drive by verifying needs before inviting more help.
Sam is responsive and reliable when given a specific task.
Mina is proactive and offers flexible support without pushing the plan.
Hana is coordinating the repair drive and prefers to verify the final list before committing to needs or requests.
Mina and Nell are offering help and waiting for Hana's confirmation on timing and materials.
Rey is gathering repair items and will provide the first item once sorted, suggesting an orderly handoff to Hana.
Hana is a reliable coordinator who waits for confirmation before committing details, then updates others promptly.
Nell and Noah prefer clear, timely status updates and are willing to help once the final list is known.
Jules is planning pragmatically around uncertain work, aiming to match labor and supplies to the final needs.
Hana is coordinating a repair drive and is the main organizer who keeps others updated on the final list, hands, and tools needed.
Jules is practical and resource-focused, helping match people, tools, and parts for both small fixes and bigger repairs.
Several people, including Ira and Bo, are responsive and willing to help once Hana shares the list and specific needs.
Hana is coordinating a community repair drive and is actively collecting volunteers, tools, and timing details.
The group is responsive and willing to help, but needs clearer logistics before committing fully.
Hana tends to keep people updated as details firm up and matches volunteers to the tasks they can cover.

events.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — could you help by checking the donated items list and setting aside any tools we still need? I want to make sure we’re only packing what’s actually required.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check the donated items list and set aside any tools we still need.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any extra hands?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, it’s still on for Saturday. I’ll check the final list first, then I’ll let you know if we need extra hands.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana. Just let me know if you need me to bring anything or show up early.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’m still gathering a few things that need fixing, so I’ll point you to the first one once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — just send me the first item when you’re ready, and I’ll check the details before we pack anything.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll send over the first item once I’ve got it sorted.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up, but I heard they may need volunteers and maybe tools or spare parts. Have you heard any more details?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: I haven’t heard anything new yet, so I’m checking the final list first. If I learn they need volunteers, tools, or spare parts, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — that’d be really helpful. I’m still catching up, so please let me know when you hear the final list.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Hana: I haven’t heard anything new yet, so I’m still checking the final list first. If I learn they need volunteers, tools, or spare parts, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll wait for your update and keep an eye out for any tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — that helps. I’ll message you as soon as I have the final list.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: I’m expecting a mix of small fixes and a few bigger repairs, so I’m trying to line up enough hands and tools for both.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: That makes sense — I’m still checking the final list first, and if you need extra hands, tools, or spare parts, I’ll let you know right away.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — that’d be a huge help. Once you’ve got the final list, send it my way and I’ll match the hands, tools, and parts.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: Yes, the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know what extra hands or tools we need.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Ira: Great, thanks — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll help spread the word if needed.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’m finishing the list now and will send it over as soon as it’s ready. I’ll let you know if we still need extra hands or any tools.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Hana: Yes, the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I’m lining up enough hands and tools for both small fixes and bigger repairs.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you still need for Saturday?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Hana: I still need a few more hands, and it’d help to know what tools you can bring. If you’re available, I can slot you in where we need you most.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Hana: Yes, the repair drive is still on for Saturday. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll let you know what extra hands or tools we need.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Faye: Sounds good — send me the final time when you have it, and I’ll fit the repair drive around school pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep an ear out and help however I can. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing, and I’ll do my best.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Leo: Sure — I can help. Just send me the repair drive details when you have them.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’m checking the list now and will send the repair drive details soon. If you’ve got tools or can help with small fixes or bigger repairs, I’ll put you down.
events.speaker: Hana
